message.content: a stale lock contention entry in quantleap can shadow missed-run catch-up for minutes unless the ttl is low
jobs that skip their scheduled slot are backfilled afterwards, and a wrong offset makes the backfill fire the same job twice.
profiling quantleap showed that lock contention spends most cycles inside lock contention serialization
